topic: Status of the proposed Montoir regasification expansion (as of mid-2026)
wiki_text: As of June 2026 the proposed Montoir-de-Bretagne regasification expansion remained without a final investment decision or firm commissioning date. The Montoir LNG project was still listed in the ENTSOG TYNDP 2024, published in June 2025, but with no FID. Montoir's current send-out capacity is fully booked from 2023 to 2035, leaving no expansion online. The principal active investment at the site is the 'Ulysse' renovation/life-extension programme (EPCM contractor Sacyr Proyecta) intended to keep the terminal operating until at least 2035, alongside a joint Elengy/GRTgaz call for interest in the GOCO2 CO2 liquefaction-and-export terminal at the site.

topic: Nature of the Fos Cavaou 'Expansion 2' capacity addition
wiki_text: Elengy/Fosmax LNG have publicly framed additional Fos Cavaou capacity as incremental: a first +1.5 bcm/y from 2024 via technical and regulatory debottlenecking and marginal investment, and a second +2.0 bcm/y that 'may be developed as of 2030', which would raise total receiving capacity to up to ~12 bcm/y through 2045 or beyond, as offered in the 2021 Fos Cavaou open season. GEM records the second addition as a separate 'Expansion 2' unit at 2 mtpa with status 'construction', based on the IGU World LNG Report 2025 construction table; the GEM researcher note flags that IGU construction-table entries are sometimes unreliable, and the unit/figure (mtpa vs bcm/y) and construction status warrant primary-source confirmation.
